세면.englishDescription: The act of washing one's face with water.

수건돌리기.englishDescription: drop the handkerchief game: A game in which a player goes around the people who are sitting in a circle, drops the handkerchief and runs away.

수다.definitionKo: 쓸데없이 말이 많음. 또는 그런 말.

수도원.definitionKo: 가톨릭에서, 수도사나 수녀들이 일정한 규율 아래 공동생활을 하며 도를 닦는 곳.

숙달하다.definitionKo: 익숙하게 잘 알고 솜씨 있게 잘하다.

숙식.englishDescription: The act of sleeping and eating.

순대.definitionKo: 당면, 두부, 찹쌀 등을 양념하여 돼지의 창자 속에 넣고 찐 음식.

쉿.englishDescription: A word mimicking the sound made urgently or firmly when telling a person to stop making loud noises and be quiet.

신념.definitionKo: 어떤 생각을 굳게 믿는 마음. 또는 그것을 이루려는 의지.

신앙.englishDescription: The act of believing in a god and revering it.

핏대(가) 서다[나다/돋다/오르다].definitionKo: 몹시 화를 낼 때 피가 몰려 얼굴과 목의 핏대가 붉어지다.
핏대(가) 서다[나다/돋다/오르다].englishDescription: For one's blood to rush to the face and neck and make the veins there grow red when one gets very angry.

핑계 없는 무덤이 없다.definitionKo: 아무리 큰 잘못을 저지른 사람도 그것을 변명하고 이유를 붙일 수 있다.
핑계 없는 무덤이 없다.englishDescription: Even a person who makes big mistakes has his/her own excuses or reasons.
핑계 없는 무덤이 없다.englishExpression: There is no tomb without excuses

하나같이.definitionKo: 모두가 조금도 다른 데가 없이 꼭 같이.
하나같이.englishDescription: In such a manner that two or more persons or things are not a bit different from each other in appearance, reaction, etc.

하루.definitionKo: 밤 열두 시부터 다음 날 밤 열두 시까지의 스물네 시간.
하루.englishDescription: The 24 hours from midnight to the following midnight.

하루.definitionKo: 사람이 아침부터 해가 지기까지 활동하는 시간.
하루.englishDescription: The hours from sunrise to sunset when people engage in their activities.

하며.definitionKo: 잇달아 쓰인 둘 이상의 비슷한 사물을 이어 줄 때 쓰는 조사.
하며.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to connect two or more similar referents that are stated consecutively.
entryAnnotations: 명사 뒤에 붙여 쓴다.
붙여쓰기를 허용한다.

학령.englishDescription: The age for entering elementary school.

학령.definitionKo: 초등학교에서 의무 교육을 받아야 할 나이의 시기.
학령.englishDescription: The age at which one is required to receive education in elementary school.

학연.englishDescription: Social connections formed among graduates of the same school.

한날.englishDescription: A state of falling on the same day.

한방.englishExpression: the entire room; the whole room

한방.englishDescription: The medical practice that was developed in China and passed on to Korea.

합류.definitionKo: 여러 물줄기가 하나로 모여 흐름. 또는 그 물줄기.
합류.englishDescription: A state in which several streams of water join together to flow into a river, sea, etc.; or such a stream.

합류.definitionKo: 같은 목적을 이루기 위해 여러 사람이나 집단이 한데 모임.
합류.englishDescription: A state in which many people or groups join together to achieve a common goal.
합류.englishExpression: joining; joining the ranks; joining the forces

합법화하다.englishDescription: To recognize something as in accordance with law and rule.

항구성.englishDescription: The quality of lasting for long without changing over time.

항로.englishDescription: A way or route on the sea, followed by a boat when it travels.
A way or route in the air, followed by a plane when it travels.

해바라기.definitionKo: 높이는 2미터 정도이고, 늦여름에 피는 노랗고 둥글넓적한 큰 꽃.
해바라기.englishDescription: A 2-meter-long, large flower blooming in late summer, featuring yellow, flat and round petals.

해부도.definitionKo: 생물의 내부 구조를 자세하게 그린 그림.
해부도.englishDescription: A picture that describes the internal structure of an organism in detail.

해약.definitionKo: 약속이나 계약 등이 깨짐. 또는 약속이나 계약 등을 깨뜨림.
해약.englishDescription: A state in which a promise or contract is broken; or an act of breaking a promise or contract.

해약.definitionKo: 계약을 한 한쪽이 계약으로 성립된 관계를 취소함.
해약.englishDescription: A state in which one party of a contract ends the contractual relationship with another.

향신료.englishDescription: Condiment used to add spicy taste or flavor to food.

향하다.englishDescription: To face a certain object or direction.
To move toward a certain goal or objective.
To pay attention or turn one's mind to a certain object.

향하다.definitionKo: 무엇이 어느 한 방향을 바라보게 하다.
향하다.englishDescription: To make someone look in a certain direction.

향학열.englishDescription: Enthusiasm to study hard to learn something.
향학열.englishExpression: desire to learn; passion for learning

허례허식하다.definitionKo: 형편에 맞지 않게 겉만 화려하게 꾸미다.
허례허식하다.englishDescription: To make something showy outwardly only beyond one's means.

허리를 굽히다.englishDescription: To take a humble attitude toward someone.
To give a bow to someone politely.

허리춤.definitionKo: 바지나 치마처럼 허리가 있는 옷의 허리 안쪽.
허리춤.englishDescription: The inner part of the waist in clothing such as trousers or skirt.

허무적.definitionKo: 인생이나 세상일을 허무한 것이라고 생각하는 경향이 있는.
허무적.englishDescription: Showing a tendency to consider life or everyday affairs vain.

허무적.definitionKo: 인생이나 세상일을 허무한 것이라고 생각하는 경향이 있는 것.
허무적.englishDescription: A state of having a tendency to consider life or everyday affairs vain.

헌정하다.definitionKo: 가치 있는 것을 남에게 주거나 바치다.
헌정하다.englishDescription: To give or offer a valuable thing to another.

혀에 굳은살이 박이도록.englishExpression: to such an extent that a callus forms on one's tongue

호락호락.definitionKo: 일이나 사람이 만만하여 다루기 쉬운 모양.
호락호락.englishDescription: In the state of a task or person being pliable enough to be easily managed.

호박이 넝쿨째로 굴러떨어졌다.definitionKo: 뜻밖에 좋은 물건을 얻거나 행운을 만났다.
호박이 넝쿨째로 굴러떨어졌다.englishDescription: To gain a good product or have good luck unexpectedly.
호박이 넝쿨째로 굴러떨어졌다.englishExpression: A pumpkin with its vines on drops in one's lap; got a windfall

호송하다.englishDescription: To accompany another to his/her destination for protection.

호송하다.definitionKo: 죄를 지은 사람을 목적지까지 감시하면서 데려가다.
호송하다.englishDescription: To accompany a criminal to his/her destination while keeping an eye on him/her.

호피.englishDescription: The fur of a tiger or leopard.

혼령.englishDescription: The disembodied soul of a dead person.

혼비백산.definitionKo: 혼백이 이곳저곳으로 흩어진다는 뜻으로, 매우 놀라서 정신을 잃음.
혼비백산.englishDescription: A phrase literally meaning souls scatter in all directions, referring to a state of losing one's consciousness from fright.
혼비백산.englishExpression: being scared to death; being frightened out of one's wits

홈경기.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서, 팀의 본거지에서 하는 경기.
홈경기.englishDescription: In a sports competition, a match played at the team's home ground.

홍시.englishDescription: A persimmon that has ripened and therefore is red and very soft.

화친.definitionKo: 나라와 나라 사이에 싸움이 없이 서로 가까이 지냄.
화친.englishDescription: A state in which two or more countries are on good terms, without any fighting.

확실하다.englishDescription: Being absolutely true or being certain of something.

환기되다.definitionKo: 주의나 여론, 생각 등이 일어나게 되다.
환기되다.englishDescription: For a person's attention to be brought to a certain matter, or for public opinion, thought, etc., to be stirred up.
환기되다.englishExpression: be aroused; be awakened; be stirred up

환기되다.definitionKo: 더럽고 탁한 공기가 맑은 공기로 바뀌다.
환기되다.englishDescription: For dirty, stuffy air to be changed into fresh air.

활동적.englishDescription: Moving one's body to perform some action.

활동적.definitionKo: 어떤 일에서 좋은 결과를 거두기 위해 힘쓰는.
활동적.englishDescription: Striving to achieve a good result in a certain task.
A state of moving one's body to perform some action.

활동적.definitionKo: 어떤 일에서 좋은 결과를 거두기 위해 힘쓰는 것.
활동적.englishDescription: A state of striving to achieve a good result in a certain task.

활보하다.englishDescription: To walk with long steps energetically, confidently.

활보하다.definitionKo: 힘차고 당당하게 행동하거나 제멋대로 마구 행동하다.
활보하다.englishDescription: To act energetically and confidently, or act carelessly without reserve.
활보하다.englishExpression: move around; roam around; behave imprudently

황야.englishDescription: A barren land that is left uncultivated.

회복하다.definitionKo: 아프거나 약해졌던 몸을 다시 예전의 상태로 돌이키다.
회복하다.englishDescription: To have the health of a sick or weak person return to a normal condition.

회복하다.definitionKo: 잃었던 것을 되찾거나 나빠졌던 것을 원래의 상태로 돌이키다.
회복하다.englishDescription: To take back what one has lost or to restore what has been damaged to its original state.

회충.definitionKo: 길이는 15~30센티미터 정도로, 사람 몸의 작은창자에 사는 기생충.
회충.englishDescription: A 15 to 30 centimeter-long-parasite that lives in the small intestines of a human body.

횡행.englishDescription: A state of acting as one pleases without reserve.

효부.englishDescription: A daughter-in-law who takes good care of her parents-in-law.

후궁.definitionKo: 왕이 아내 외에 데리고 사는 여자.
후궁.englishDescription: A woman a king lives with other than his legal wife.

후궁.definitionKo: 중심이 되는 궁궐의 뒤쪽에 있는 궁궐.
후궁.englishDescription: A palace located at the rear of a central palace.

후안무치하다.englishDescription: Being ignorant about saving face and lacking a sense of shame.

후유.definitionKo: 일이 힘들거나 걱정이 있을 때 크고 길게 내쉬는 소리.
후유.englishDescription: An exclamation that comes with a loud, long sigh, uttered when one feels tired or worried.

후유.definitionKo: 어려운 일을 끝내거나 고비를 넘겼을 때 안심하여 크고 길게 내쉬는 소리.
후유.englishDescription: An exclamation that comes with a loud, long sigh, uttered when one is finished with a difficult task or turns a corner.

훈방하다.definitionKo: 일상생활에서 가벼운 죄를 지은 사람을 훈계하여 풀어 주다.
훈방하다.englishDescription: To admonish and release a person who has committed a minor crime in daily life.
훈방하다.englishExpression: release on warning; give a caution

휘둥그레지다.definitionKo: 놀라거나 무서워서 눈이 크고 둥그렇게 되다.
휘둥그레지다.englishDescription: For eyes to become large and round, wide open, being frightened or scared by something.

휴가비.definitionKo: 직장 등에서 휴가를 얻은 사람에게 주는 돈.
휴가비.englishDescription: Money offered by a company to its employees who go on a vacation.

휴강.englishDescription: An of cancelling a class or lecture.

흐느적거리다.definitionKo: 나뭇가지나 천 등의 가늘고 긴 물체가 자꾸 느리게 흔들리다.
흐느적거리다.englishDescription: For a thin, long object such as a twig or cloth, etc., to move back and forth slowly, repeatedly.

흐느적거리다.definitionKo: 생활이나 마음을 다잡지 못하고 자꾸 헤매다.
흐느적거리다.englishDescription: To keep wandering without composing one's mind or having a grip on one's own life.

흐느적거리다.definitionKo: 노래의 가락이 늘어지고 처지며 계속 이어지다.
흐느적거리다.englishDescription: For the melody of a song to continue in a draggingly slow and subdued manner.

흐느적거리다.definitionKo: 팔다리 등이 힘없이 느리게 자꾸 움직이다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
흐느적거리다.englishDescription: For one's arms or legs, etc., to move feebly, slowly in a repeated manner; or to make them move in such a manner.

흐늘거리다.definitionKo: 힘없이 늘어져 느리게 자꾸 흔들리다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
흐늘거리다.englishDescription: To droop feebly and sway slowly, repeatedly; or to make this happen.

흐늘거리다.definitionKo: 물체가 단단하지 못해 자꾸 뭉개지거나 흔들리다.
흐늘거리다.englishDescription: For something to be so soft-textured that it sways or cannot hold its shape.
To enjoy one's life, doing as one pleases.

흐트러뜨리다.englishDescription: To scatter things and make them entangled in a disorderly manner.

흐트러뜨리다.definitionKo: 겉모습, 자세, 태도 등을 단정하지 않게 하다.
흐트러뜨리다.englishDescription: To lose one's composure in posture or fail to straighten one's conduct, attitude, etc.

흐트러뜨리다.definitionKo: 정신을 어지럽게 하여 집중하지 못하게 하다.
흐트러뜨리다.englishDescription: To distract someone to keep him/her from concentrating on something.

흡착하다.englishDescription: For a certain substance to become attached to something else.

흥행.definitionKo: 돈을 받고 연극이나 영화 등을 사람들에게 보여 줌.
흥행.englishDescription: An act of showing a play or movie to the audience in return for money.

흥행.definitionKo: 연극이나 영화 등의 공연이 상업적으로 큰 수익을 거둠.
흥행.englishDescription: The state of a performance or show such as a play, movie, etc., making a big profit commercially.
흥행.englishExpression: box office hit; box office success

흥행되다.definitionKo: 돈이 지불되고 연극이나 영화 등이 사람들에게 보이다.
흥행되다.englishDescription: For a play or movie to be shown to the audience in return for money.

흥행되다.definitionKo: 연극이나 영화 등의 공연이 상업적으로 큰 수익을 거두게 되다.
흥행되다.englishDescription: For a performance or show such as a play, movie, etc., to make a big profit commercially.
흥행되다.englishExpression: be a box office hit; be a box office success
